issues.detail: The Greek 'κατεβη ουτος δεδικαιωμενος εις τον οικον αυτου' (this one, justified, went down to his house) describes the *action* of the person going down after being justified. The Vietnamese translation 'người nầy xuống nhà mình được xưng công bình hơn người kia' incorrectly renders it as a comparison of degree ('more justified than the other'), which is not in the Greek.
The Greek structure implies a contrast between two specific individuals (this one vs. that one) regarding their actions/status, but the Vietnamese renders it as a general comparison of 'more' (hơn).
